Assertion audit (reading only; no mutation or suite rerun):
- tests/test_a_gate_creates_its_log.py:75-82: restoring truncating opens changes sentinel bytes/mtime or creates the dangling target, accepts the collision, runs the independent command marker, or replaces the symlink; each assertion has an observable failure condition.
- :90-92: suppressing execution, dropping captured stdout, or dropping the final receipt fails the independent marker/receipt assertions; the command supplies fixed output, not an expected value derived from a returned argument.
- :107-118 and :134-147: restoring truncation removes FileExistsError and damages the sentinel or creates the dangling target; the scheduler regular-file branch checks bytes but does not separately assert its mtime.
- :165-173: removing reservation makes the empty log/file assertions fail; a broken shell wrapper changes the actual exit code or exact captured marker/receipt; removing append mode fails the argv assertion.
- :212-217: resolving symlinks or accepting collisions makes the arm readable, invokes the recording scheduler or changes the independent target snapshot.
- :248-251: reusing an earlier arm path fails the disjoint-path assertion, truncation changes its bytes/mtime, and refusal rather than retry makes the second arm exit status nonzero/unreadable.
- :278-282: not submitting changes the scheduler call count, accepting a stale EXIT=0 changes the refusal, clearing the stale receipt changes its bytes/mtime, and copying stale output leaks old-marker into the replay log.
- tests/test_a_gate_replay_runs_on_the_measure_partition.py:89 and :265-269: removing precreation fails the fixture file assertion; clearing/reusing the stale path changes its snapshot or violates submitted != stale; accepting stale evidence fails the retained failed-verdict assertions.
- tests/test_an_acceptance_check_holds_no_lease.py:47 and tests/test_cleanly_reviewed_run_lands_itself.py:128: removing reservation or handing the scheduler a symlink fails these fixture assertions; existing lease, partition, promotion and verdict checks remain intact.
No added assertion compares a returned argument to the same input as its sole regression oracle. The fake scheduler's file-existence assertions are not claimed as sole safety coverage: independent snapshot and command-suppression assertions cover the refusal.

Reuse audit: searched execution-log path selection, exclusive creation and temporary-file creation in the repository; opened reckon/_store.py:517-562 and production callers at the reviewed head. _unused_log_path is the only added production capability; _rerun_gate_at_integrated_revision is the existing body moved behind a reservation wrapper. New test definitions extend the existing pytest fixture and runner mechanisms.

Failure delta: the completed baseline_suite receipt has no FAILED ids; the completed after_suite receipt has exactly tests/test_an_acceptance_check_holds_no_lease.py::test_a_changed_stored_review_rejudges_the_same_head, yielding one added failure. The head receipt names source c0abdc7bfb8679b5030c8b2033c75df9516efaee plus fixture overlay 4e156982398d88a38e52900ecd31776f3923a508; git inspection confirms the final commit changes only those three overlaid tests and preserves the three product module blobs. Importer receipts separately record eight identical failures at both revisions; they do not erase the armed-suite failure.
